prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult Cuban woman — the personification of Havana — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Havana as her world knows it — a far-future city two centuries from now: sleek curved architecture, smart glowing materials, holographic interfaces, layered levels of the city and quiet flying vehicles; even an everyday place is rebuilt in that future, not today's Havana with neon added. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, towers, giant holograms or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: a narrow street of old colonial houses kept two centuries on, their coral, lemon and sky-blue walls glowing softly from within and slim light-lines tracing the columns and balconies.
Around her, as her world makes them: a tiny glass cup of thick, sweet dark coffee crowned with pale sugar foam, on a softly glowing saucer; a holographic phone screen projected from her wrist; a reflective sling bag with a glowing zip line.
Season: the cool dry months — November to February, sunny and mild at around 22°C, the lightest rain of the year and now and then a winter cold front off the sea.
Weather: a winter cold front — a strong wind whipping up the sea so great waves burst over the seawall onto the avenue, spray flying in the grey light.
Time of day: midday — bright, even daylight; hard bright sun, crisp short shadows on the ground.
Hair: her hair twisted up at the back of her head and held with a simple hairpin or clip, a few strands loose — same colour and length as the attached image.
Light direction: backlit — the main light comes from behind her, a bright rim along her hair and shoulders.
Outfit: a color-blocked 1990s windbreaker with matching track pants — in denim blues and indigo, with white or cream as the only second colour; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance; styled with tone-on-tone embroidery, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday techwear — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of technical fabrics with reflective panels, glowing seam lines, magnetic clasps and chunky-soled boots.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a close-up of her face and hair; body facing the camera; head tilted slightly, her face turned a little toward the right of the frame; camera slightly below, looking up at her; her head and body angles are set by this line, not taken from the attached image.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand makes a V sign beside her face — one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: softly lowered brows, warm relaxed eyes, faint closed-lip smile, no tension anywhere.

Framing: a close-up — her face and hair fill most of the frame and the bottom edge crosses at her collarbones; nothing below the shoulders shows, and her hands and anything she holds stay below the frame unless raised to her face.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a gleaming chrome hood ornament shaped like a swept-back rocket — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.
acceptance: User selected world candidate 1; preauthorized ordinary main updates.
